description: U+FEFF incidental (1), write route variable: DAO QueryDef (PARAMETERS pT TEXT(255); INSERT ... VALUES (id, [pT], [pT])) with a fresh QueryDef per value and Parameter.Value puts, rows lone, leading, trailing and plain, ACCDB. Table W(ID LONG key, T TEXT(255), M MEMO) holds values ID 1 feff, ID 2 lead-ascii, ID 3 trail-ascii, ID 4 inner, ID 5 lead-euro, ID 6 lead-latin1, ID 7 double, ID 8 feff-fffe, ID 9 fffe-lead, ID 10 plain, ID 11 lead-long (lead-long is U+FEFF then 100 x; double is two U+FEFF; feff-fffe is U+FEFF U+FFFE; fffe-lead is U+FFFE ab). After closing, the table is read twice: a DAO snapshot of ID, T, M, Len, AscW of positions 1-3 of T and 1-2 of M, and an ADO recordset of ID, T, M, Len(T), Len(M). Asks which positions of a U+FEFF are lost, whether write route or read route changes it, and whether the loss is at write (all routes agree) or read.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-wire probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

args.text: CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(255), M MEMO)
PARAMETERS pT TEXT(255); INSERT INTO W (ID, T, M) VALUES (1, [pT], [pT])
PARAMETERS pT TEXT(255); INSERT INTO W (ID, T, M) VALUES (2, [pT], [pT])
PARAMETERS pT TEXT(255); INSERT INTO W (ID, T, M) VALUES (3, [pT], [pT])

SELECT ID, T, M, Len(T) AS LT, Len(M) AS LM, AscW(Mid(T,1,1)) AS T1, AscW(Mid(T,2,1)) AS T2, AscW(Mid(T,3,1)) AS T3, AscW(Mid(M,1,1)) AS M1, AscW(Mid(M,2,1)) AS M2 FROM W ORDER BY ID
